title: Inter beat Como 2-0 — and Chivu already looks past November
caption:
Inter 2-0 Como, both goals in by the 19th — Esposito 12', Thuram 19'. Chivu, per Inter.it: "L'importante è come si arriva a marzo" — what matters is how you arrive in March. Separately, Fabrizio Romano (via FCInterNews) reports Inter want to open talks with Thuram's agent. Nothing signed.
